event.event_name: 2023 Florida Keys marine heatwave and coral bleaching
event.hazard_label: Marine heatwave and coastal ecosystem impact

priority_model.primary_priority: protect live nursery corals and genetically unique staghorn/elkhorn fragments before severe DHW accumulation outruns rescue capacity
priority_model.second_priority: coordinate Keys road/bridge logistics for tank transport, lab capacity, and staff access
priority_model.third_priority: monitor additional heat days because the DHW clock accelerates with anomaly persistence

recommended_reasoning_path: Convert SST above the bleaching threshold into DHW accumulation time, rather than only describing warm water.
Compare the 4 and 8 C-week clocks with the June 14 to July 13 threshold-to-peak interval.
Use rescue text and local logistics exposure to explain why timing matters for coral triage.
Use remote-sensing summaries only as ecosystem/coastal context, not as direct coral mortality counts.

criteria.name: json_and_sources
criteria.description: Returns JSON and cites event/report, population, OSM, embedding, and Sentinel-2 context files.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for valid JSON using report only.

criteria.name: thermal_clock
criteria.description: Extracts MMM 29.63 C, bleaching threshold 30.63 C, peak SST 33.60 C, exceedance 2.97 C, June 14 to July 13 as 29 days, and 12.3 C-weeks by peak date.

criteria.name: dhw_escalation
criteria.description: Computes 9.4 days to 4 C-weeks, 18.9 days to 8 C-weeks, 5.9 additional C-weeks for 14 more peak days, total 18.2 C-weeks, and 16.1 days to 8 C-weeks with +0.5 C.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for correct DHW formula with missing scenario.

criteria.name: ecological_rescue_context
criteria.description: Uses record-warm, widespread bleaching/death, Mission: Iconic Reef, nursery relocation, and staghorn/elkhorn preservation clues.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for ecological context without rescue timing.

criteria.name: logistics_reasoning
criteria.description: Connects WorldPop, roads, major roads, bridges, and schools to Keys transport and lab-rescue logistics.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for exposure counts without logistics interpretation.

criteria.name: limits
criteria.description: Does not infer exact reef-by-reef mortality or daily observed DHW from summary text alone.

provenance.notes: Flagship Q3 task: multi-file package-local computation plus disaster mechanism reasoning.
